title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame
tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

faults.what: The delivered frame appears slightly taller and narrower than the requested 9:16 ratio.
The portrait appears subtly regenerated rather than simply placed: facial details and the sweater's knit pattern differ from the source.

judge.summary: The image preserves the woman's hair and shoulders over a blurred background, but needs an exact 9:16 frame and better preservation of the original portrait.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
must_haves.why: The visible output is slightly taller and narrower than 9:16.

must_haves.item: The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
must_haves.why: The same woman, dark curls and gray knit sweater remain recognizable, despite subtle detail changes.

must_haves.item: No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
must_haves.why: All visible curls and both shoulder areas remain within the foreground image.

must_haves.item: The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
must_haves.why: The face and body retain natural proportions without obvious stretching or squeezing.

must_haves.item: Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.
must_haves.why: The added top and bottom areas use blurred source-photo colors and forms, and no text is visible.
